Subject: Coordinating Lumina Health case study — discovery call, stakeholders & recording consent

Hi Alyssa / Raj —

Thanks again for agreeing to help us with a customer story. I want to get a short discovery call on the calendar this week to align on stakeholders, scope, and get permission to record a short interview. Proposed items:

- 30-minute discovery call (we'll record for internal notes + optional excerpt for the case study)
- Draft agenda (attached): goals, key results, timelines, and sensitive data boundaries
- Release/recording form (attached) — please sign or confirm via reply if you're comfortable

Proposed slots (Pacific):
- Wed 2026-08-05 10:00–10:30am
- Wed 2026-08-05 3:00–3:30pm
- Thu 2026-08-06 11:00–11:30am

If those don't work, share three windows that do. Also, can you confirm the attendees from Lumina who should join? From our side: Markus (product), Monica (CS), and me (marketing).

Quick note on recording: we capture audio + a short video so we can pull 30–60s clips for the final write-up. We can anonymize quotes or redact customer-specific names on request. If you prefer a transcript only and no publishable clips, let us know.

Attachments: lumina-case-agenda-draft-20260803.pdf (PDF), lumina-recording-release.docx (DOCX)

Cheers,

Tessa Morgan
Senior Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Coordinating Lumina Health case study — discovery call, stakeholders & recording consent

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the clear options. We can do Wed 2026-08-05 at 3:00pm PT. I'll send a calendar invite once we confirm. Attendees from Lumina will be:

- Alyssa Chen (myself) — Dir, Customer Success
- Raj Patel — Engineering lead, integrations
- Michael Torres — Director, Data Privacy (can join first 10 mins to weigh on data boundaries)
- Sofia Rivera — PM for the team (will be on the call)

On recording: we're generally fine with audio/video for internal notes. For public excerpts, we'd like the option to review clips and redact any patient-identifiable information or downstream customer references. If you can highlight in the release form a clause that allows Lumina to review snippets prior to publish, that would speed approvals. Otherwise, we can sign the attached doc.

Also, one small ask on the agenda: can you add a 5 minute section to talk licensing/ok-to-publish for screenshots (screenshots may show sample UI with client names anonymized)?

I'll tentatively accept the 3pm slot — please send the invite and we'll finalize.

Thanks,
Alyssa

Tessa / Alyssa —

Thanks — 3pm PT on Wed works for our team. I added a short set of example questions for the discovery section (attached as a one-pager) — mostly focused on measurable outcomes, integration timeline, and any anonymized metrics you can share.

Alyssa: absolutely agree on the review step for publishable clips and screenshots. We'll add a line to the release doc to include a Lumina approval checkpoint (48-hour review window for any publishable media).

Small agenda tweak suggestion: order the call as
1) Introductions & scope (5 min)
2) Security/data boundaries (5 min) — Michael join here
3) Outcomes & metrics (10 min)
4) Approvals & publishing process (5 min)
5) Next steps & timelines (5 min)

Attachments: lumina-discovery-questions-20260804.pdf (PDF)

-Markus

I'll also upload a short internal one-pager on measurable metrics we'll be comfortable publishing — will send before the call.
